headers.name: base
headers.doc: The base of the Maul RHI API: the library and contract versions, the export and attribute macros, the result codes every fallible function returns, the allocator and the extension chain.

items.name: result
items.doc: The status a fallible function returns. Zero is success, positive values are outcomes that are not errors, negative values are errors. The type has a fixed width so that result structs have one layout in C and C++.

values.name: success
values.doc: The call did what was asked.

values.name: empty
values.doc: There is nothing to return: the notification queue is drained.

values.name: timeout
values.doc: A wait's deadline passed first; what it waited for is still running.

values.name: error_invalid
values.doc: An argument is invalid: a null pointer where one is required, a value out of range, a def without its cookie.

values.name: error_capacity
values.doc: A caller buffer, a named limit or the allocator is too small for the result.

values.name: error_stale
values.doc: An id names an object that no longer exists.

values.name: error_unsupported
values.doc: This platform, driver or build cannot do what was asked, or a def carries a critical extension the library does not know.

values.name: error_platform
values.doc: The platform or its GPU driver failed a call the library made.

values.name: error_state
values.doc: The call is not allowed now, in the object's current state.

values.name: error_version
values.doc: The program was built against another contract version.

items.name: version
items.doc: A library version: major, minor and patch.

items.name: allocator
items.doc: The allocator an owner object takes in its def and keeps for its lifetime. Alignment is a power of two. A zeroed allocator means the C library's functions, which serve alignments up to that of max_align_t.

items.name: struct_type
items.doc: The type of a chained struct. Bit 31 clear marks a critical extension, which a library that does not know it refuses; bit 31 set marks a hint it may skip.

values.name: struct_none
values.doc: No struct: never valid in a chain.

values.name: struct_test_driver
values.doc: mrhiTestDriverDef, on an instance def: turns the test driver on.

values.name: struct_surface_source_test
values.doc: mrhiSurfaceSourceTest, on a surface def: a surface of the test driver.

items.name: chain
items.doc: The header every chained struct opens with. A def's next field, or a chained struct's chain.next, points at the next struct of the chain, or is NULL.

items.name: label_bytes
items.doc: The bytes a debug label may take, in UTF-8.

items.name: request_id
items.doc: A request, answered by exactly one notification in its owner's queue.

items.name: get_version
items.doc: Returns the version of the library that was linked, which may differ from the MRHI_VERSION macros a program was compiled with.

returns.doc: The library version.

items.name: result_name
items.doc: Returns the name of a result code, for diagnostics.

returns.doc: A static, NUL-terminated string such as "mrhi_errorCapacity".

args.name: result
args.doc: Any value; an unknown one is named as such.

items.name: instance_notification_kind
items.doc: What an instance notification reports.

values.name: instance_adapters_found
values.doc: An adapter request is answered: its outcome is mrhi_success, and mrhiGetAdapters lists the adapters, mrhi_errorStale when its compatible surface ended before the answer, or another error.

values.name: instance_device_ready
values.doc: A device finished opening: its outcome is mrhi_success and the device is ready, or an error and the device failed. A device destroyed while opening answers mrhi_errorStale.

items.name: instance_notification
items.doc: A record from an instance's notification queue.

members.name: request_id
members.doc: The request the record answers.

members.name: outcome
members.doc: How the request ended.

items.name: instance_limits
items.doc: The named limits of an instance.

members.name: chain_depth
members.doc: Chained structs one def may carry; 8 by default.

members.name: notifications
members.doc: Records the notification queue holds; 64 by default.

members.name: adapters
members.doc: Adapters the instance keeps; 16 by default.

members.name: surfaces
members.doc: Surfaces the instance holds at once; 16 by default.

items.name: instance_def
items.doc: How an instance is made. Build it with mrhiDefaultInstanceDef.

members.name: contract_version
members.doc: MRHI_CONTRACT_VERSION, as the program was built.

items.name: default_instance_def
items.doc: Returns the default instance def: the contract version the program is built against, the C library's allocator and the default limits (8 chained structs per def, 64 notifications, 16 adapters).

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.name: create_instance
items.doc: Makes an instance.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a def without its cookie, a zero limit or an allocator with one function; `mrhi_errorVersion` when the def's contract version is not the library's; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know, such as mrhiTestDriverDef in a build without the test driver; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the chain is deeper than the limit or the allocator fails.

args.name: instance_out
args.doc: Receives the instance; set to NULL on failure.

items.name: destroy_instance
items.doc: Destroys an instance. While any of its devices exists it refuses, counting the call as misuse and destroying nothing.

args.name: instance
args.doc: The instance, or NULL for nothing.

items.name: get_instance_misuse
items.doc: Returns how many calls the instance has refused as invalid input (mrhi_errorInvalid): a count release builds can watch to catch a caller's bugs. Stale ids are not misuse.

returns.doc: The count; 0 for a NULL instance.

items.name: default_adapter_request_def
items.doc: Returns the default adapter request def: the driver's own order, software rasterizers allowed.

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.name: request_adapters
items.doc: Asks the instance's drivers for adapters. The request is answered by one mrhi_instanceAdaptersFound record; until then, mrhiGetAdapters lists the adapters found before.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with the request accepted; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument or a def without its cookie; `mrhi_errorStale` for a compatible surface the instance no longer has; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the notification queue has no room for the answer.

items.name: next_instance_notification
items.doc: Takes the oldest record from the instance's notification queue, first polling its drivers for finished work.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with a record; `mrhi_empty` when the queue is drained; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: get_adapters
items.doc: Lists the adapters the last answered request found, best first by its preference.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL instance or count, or a NULL array with a capacity.

args.name: adapters
args.doc: Receives up to capacity ids. May be NULL when capacity is 0.

args.name: count_out
args.doc: Receives the number of adapters, which may exceed capacity.

items.name: get_adapter_info
items.doc: Reads what an adapter is.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has.

items.name: create_device
items.doc: Makes a device on an adapter. It returns at once with the device opening, and the instance's queue answers the request with mrhi_instanceDeviceReady.

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.name: create_compute_pipeline
items.doc: Makes a compute pipeline on a ready device. It returns at once with the pipeline pending, and the device's queue answers the request with mrhi_devicePipelineReady; a pipeline is usable once that answer is mrhi_success.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with the pipeline pending; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a def without its cookie, a bad label, an entry the shader has not as a compute entry, a constant the shader has not, twice, or with a value its type cannot hold, or a constant without a default left unset; `mrhi_errorStale` for a shader the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know; `mrhi_errorState` for a device that is not ready; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the device's pipeline limit is reached or its queue has no room for the answer; `mrhi_errorPlatform` when the driver refuses at once.

args.name: request_out
args.doc: Receives the id its ready record answers.

items.name: destroy_compute_pipeline
items.doc: Destroys a compute pipeline. A pending one's request is answered with mrhi_errorStale.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pipeline the device no longer has.

items.name: get_pipeline_cache
items.doc: Writes the device's pipeline cache, for a later device's def: the driver's compiled pipelines in a checked envelope.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with the cache written, or only its size when bytesOut is NULL; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or sizeOut; `mrhi_errorState` for a device that is not ready; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when capacity is less than the size, which sizeOut receives; `mrhi_errorPlatform` when the driver fails to write it.

args.name: bytes_out
args.doc: Receives the cache, or NULL to learn its size.

items.name: get_pipeline_cache_outcome
items.doc: Reports what became of the pipeline cache the device's def gave. An unusable cache never fails a device; it only goes unused.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` for a cache the driver took; `mrhi_empty` when the def gave none; `mrhi_errorStale` for one from another library version, driver or adapter, or one the driver declined; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a damaged one, or a NULL device.

headers.name: encoder
headers.doc: Recording: a kept pass of a compiled frame is begun, its commands recorded, and ended, all before the frame is submitted. The pass id is the encoder. Different passes may record on different threads at once; while passes record, nothing else uses the device.

items.name: viewport
items.doc: Where rendering lands: a rectangle of the targets and a depth range.

members.name: x
members.doc: Its left edge, at least -2 times the 2D texture limit.

members.name: y
members.doc: Its top edge, likewise.

members.name: width
members.doc: Its width, 0 to the 2D texture limit; the right edge at most 2 times the limit minus 1.

members.name: height
members.doc: Its height, likewise.

members.name: min_depth
members.doc: The depth its near plane maps to, 0 to 1.

members.name: max_depth
members.doc: The depth its far plane maps to, minDepth to 1.

items.name: scissor_rect
items.doc: The pixels rendering may write, within the pass's targets.

members.name: x
members.doc: Its left edge.

members.name: y
members.doc: Its top edge.

members.name: width
members.doc: Its width.

members.name: height
members.doc: Its height.

items.name: whole_size
items.doc: A buffer binding's size that reaches the buffer's end.

items.name: binding
items.doc: One slot of a binding table: a buffer range, a texture view or a sampler, as the slot's kind in the shader needs.

members.name: slot
members.doc: The slot, one of the table's in the pipeline's shader.

members.name: resource
members.doc: A buffer or texture of the open frame; a null id for a sampler.

members.name: offset
members.doc: A buffer's first byte, aligned to the device's uniformOffsetAlignment or storageOffsetAlignment.

members.name: size
members.doc: A buffer's bytes from the offset, or MRHI_WHOLE_SIZE for the rest; within the device's uniformBindingBytes or storageBindingBytes, at least the shader's minimum, and a multiple of 4 for storage.

members.name: view_kind
members.doc: A texture's shape as the shader sees it, as a view's kind: 2D or 2D array on any texture but a 3D one, a cube or cube array on a cube or cube array texture, 3D on a 3D texture.

members.name: view_format
members.doc: The texture's format or one of its view formats; mrhi_formatNone for the texture's.

members.name: range
members.doc: A texture's mips, layers and aspect; one mip for a storage texture.

members.name: sampler
members.doc: A sampler, for a sampler slot.

items.name: extent3d
items.doc: The size of a copy in texels, or in bytes along x for a buffer's rows.

members.name: width
members.doc: Texels across, a multiple of the format's block width.

members.name: height
members.doc: Texels down, a multiple of the format's block height.

members.name: depth_or_layers
members.doc: The depth of a 3D texture, or the layers of any other.

items.name: buffer_copy
items.doc: The buffer side of a copy with a texture: where its texels start and how they are laid out.

members.name: resource
members.doc: A buffer of the open frame.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The first texel block's byte, a multiple of the block's bytes, or of 4 for a depth or stencil aspect.

members.name: bytes_per_row
members.doc: The bytes from one row of blocks to the next, a multiple of 256 and at least a row's bytes; 0 when the copy has one row and one layer.

members.name: rows_per_image
members.doc: The rows of blocks from one layer to the next, at least the copy's rows; 0 when the copy has one layer.

items.name: texture_copy
items.doc: The texture side of a copy: a mip, the origin within it, and the aspect.

members.name: resource
members.doc: A texture of the open frame.

members.name: mip
members.doc: The mip.

members.name: x
members.doc: The origin across, a multiple of the format's block width.

members.name: y
members.doc: The origin down, a multiple of the format's block height.

members.name: z
members.doc: The first depth slice of a 3D texture, or the first layer of any other.

members.name: aspect
members.doc: The aspect: all of a color format; one of a depth format for a copy with a buffer, all of it for a copy between textures.

items.name: begin_pass
items.doc: Begins recording a kept pass of the compiled open frame. It records until mrhiEndPass; a kept pass never begun records nothing.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is culled, begun already, or a frame that is not compiled.

items.name: end_pass
items.doc: Ends recording a pass. Its debug groups must be closed.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or open debug groups; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording.

items.name: set_graphics_pipeline
items.doc: Sets the graphics pipeline later draws use, in a pass with targets. It must be ready and fit the pass's targets: their formats and sample count, and no depth or stencil writes to a read-only depth target.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, or a pipeline that does not fit its targets; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, or a pipeline that is not ready; `mrhi_errorStale` also for a pipeline the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: set_compute_pipeline
items.doc: Sets the compute pipeline later dispatches use, in a pass without targets.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a pass that renders or copies; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, or a pipeline that is not ready; `mrhi_errorStale` also for a pipeline the device no longer has; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: set_bindings
items.doc: Sets every slot of one binding table for later draws or dispatches, checked against the pass's pipeline and its declared accesses.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or bindings with a count, a pass that copies, a table past the device's bindingTables, bindings that are not exactly the table's slots in the shader, a binding its slot's kind does not take (a range out of bounds or unaligned, a view invalid for its texture or of another kind, format or sample type, a sampler of another kind), or a resource the pass declares no covering access of the needed kind for; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource or sampler that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording or has no pipeline set; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a pipeline set.

args.name: table
args.doc: The table, one the pipeline's shader declares.

args.name: bindings
args.doc: The bindings, one per slot of the table in any order; NULL when count is 0. Only read during the call.

items.name: set_vertex_buffer
items.doc: Sets the buffer later draws read one of the pipeline's vertex buffers from.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, a slot past the device's vertexBuffers, a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the vertex access, or an offset or size out of range or an offset not a multiple of 4; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: slot
args.doc: The vertex buffer's index among the pipeline's, below the device's vertexBuffers.

args.name: resource
args.doc: A buffer of the open frame the pass declares with the vertex access.

args.name: offset
args.doc: Its first byte, a multiple of 4.

args.name: size
args.doc: Its bytes from the offset, or MRHI_WHOLE_SIZE for the rest.

items.name: set_index_buffer
items.doc: Sets the buffer later indexed draws read indices from.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, a format that is not an index width, a resource that is not a buffer the pass declares with the index access, or an offset or size out of range or not a multiple of the index width; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame, a destroyed pipeline, or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: resource
args.doc: A buffer of the open frame the pass declares with the index access.

args.name: offset
args.doc: Its first byte, a multiple of the index width.

args.name: size
args.doc: Its bytes from the offset, a multiple of the index width, or MRHI_WHOLE_SIZE for the rest.

items.name: draw
items.doc: Draws vertices with the pass's pipeline, tables and vertex buffers.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, or vertex buffers too small for the vertices or instances; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed pipeline; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table or vertex buffer the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a graphics pipeline set.

items.name: draw_indexed
items.doc: Draws indexed vertices with the pass's pipeline, tables, vertex buffers and index buffer.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass without targets, an index buffer too small for the indices or instance-step vertex buffers too small for the instances; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed pipeline; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, lacks a table or vertex buffer the pipeline reads, or lacks an index buffer of the pipeline's strip index format; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a graphics pipeline set.

items.name: dispatch
items.doc: Dispatches workgroups with the pass's compute pipeline and tables.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device, a pass that renders or copies, or a count past the device's workgroupsPerDimension; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a destroyed pipeline; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording, has no pipeline set, or lacks a table the pipeline reads; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: pass
args.doc: The pass, recording, with a compute pipeline set.

items.name: copy_buffer
items.doc: Copies bytes from one buffer of the frame to another.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass with targets, offsets or a size not a multiple of 4, a range past either buffer, or one buffer as both, or a resource the pass declares no covering copy source or destination access of; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: source_offset
args.doc: Its first byte, a multiple of 4.

args.name: destination
args.doc: The buffer copied to, another one.

args.name: destination_offset
args.doc: Its first byte, a multiple of 4.

items.name: copy_buffer_to_texture
items.doc: Copies texels from a buffer of the frame into a texture's mip.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass with targets, a layout that is not aligned, is not given where needed, or does not fit the buffer, a region off the texture's blocks or past its mip, a multisampled texture, or an aspect that cannot be copied to, or a resource the pass declares no covering copy source or destination access of; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: source
args.doc: The buffer and its layout. Only read during the call.

args.name: destination
args.doc: The texture, mip, origin and aspect. Only read during the call.

args.name: size
args.doc: The texels. Only read during the call.

items.name: copy_texture_to_buffer
items.doc: Copies texels from a texture's mip into a buffer of the frame.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass with targets, a layout that is not aligned, is not given where needed, or does not fit the buffer, a region off the texture's blocks or past its mip, a multisampled texture, or an aspect that cannot be copied from, or a resource the pass declares no covering copy source or destination access of; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: source
args.doc: The texture, mip, origin and aspect. Only read during the call.

args.name: destination
args.doc: The buffer and its layout. Only read during the call.

args.name: size
args.doc: The texels. Only read during the call.

items.name: copy_texture
items.doc: Copies texels between textures of the frame, or between parts of one.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass with targets, formats that are not copy-compatible, other sample counts, a region off either texture's blocks or past its mip, a depth format or multisampled texture copied in part or by one aspect, or overlapping parts of one texture, or a resource the pass declares no covering copy source or destination access of; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or a resource that is not live; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: source
args.doc: The texture copied from. Only read during the call.

args.name: destination
args.doc: The texture copied to. Only read during the call.

args.name: size
args.doc: The texels. Only read during the call.

items.name: set_root_block
items.doc: Writes bytes of the root block later draws or dispatches read.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or bytes, a pass that copies, or an unaligned or empty write; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a write past the device's root block; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: offset
args.doc: Where the bytes go in the root block, a multiple of 4.

args.name: bytes
args.doc: The bytes. Only read during the call.

args.name: size
args.doc: How many, a multiple of 4 and at least 4, ending within the device's root block.

items.name: set_viewport
items.doc: Sets where later draws land, in a pass with targets.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass without targets, or a viewport out of range; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: viewport
args.doc: The viewport, finite, within WebGPU's ranges.

items.name: set_scissor
items.doc: Sets the pixels later draws may write, in a pass with targets.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass without targets, or a rectangle past them; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: set_blend_constant
items.doc: Sets the constant blend factors use, in a pass with targets.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a pass without targets, or a component that is not finite; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: set_stencil_reference
items.doc: Sets the reference stencil tests compare with, in a pass with targets.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a pass without targets; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: push_debug_group
items.doc: Opens a named group of the pass's commands for debugging tools.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a bad label; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: label
args.doc: Its name: UTF-8 without NUL, labelLength bytes, 1 to MRHI_LABEL_BYTES. Only read during the call.

items.name: pop_debug_group
items.doc: Closes the pass's innermost open debug group.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or no open group; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

items.name: insert_debug_marker
items.doc: Marks a point among the pass's commands for debugging tools.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL device or a bad label; `mrhi_errorStale` for a pass of another frame or none; `mrhi_errorState` for a pass that is not recording; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the frame's commands are full.

args.name: label
args.doc: Its name: UTF-8 without NUL, labelLength bytes, 1 to MRHI_LABEL_BYTES. Only read during the call.

headers.name: test
headers.doc: The test driver (MAUL_RHI_TEST_DRIVER): a driver without a GPU whose adapters a test describes, for the library's tests and a program's own.

items.name: test_adapter
items.doc: An adapter the test driver finds: its facts, features and limits, and how a device opening on it ends.

members.name: open_outcome
members.doc: The outcome of a device opening on the adapter: mrhi_success, or the error the device fails with.

members.name: limited_format
members.doc: A format the adapter reports limitedCaps for instead of its usual capabilities, to test adapters below the floor; mrhi_formatNone for none.

members.name: objects_before_failure
members.doc: Objects a device on the adapter makes before every further one fails with mrhi_errorPlatform; 0 for no failure.

members.name: hold_frames
members.doc: Keeps submitted frames running until a wait with a nonzero timeout, so that a device fills its frames in flight; otherwise frames finish at the next poll.

members.name: frame_outcome
members.doc: The outcome its devices' frames finish with; mrhi_success by default.

members.name: pipeline_outcome
members.doc: What pipelines made on the adapter's devices are answered with at the next poll: mrhi_success, or the error their creation fails with.

items.name: test_driver_def
items.doc: Turns the test driver on for an instance, chained on its def with the type mrhi_structTestDriver. The test driver is the only driver of such an instance.

members.name: adapters
members.doc: The adapters the driver finds, in its own order. May be NULL when adapterCount is 0.

items.name: surface_source_test
items.doc: A surface of the test driver, chained on a surface def with the type mrhi_structSurfaceSourceTest.

members.name: caps
members.doc: What the surface can do on the adapters that present to it; the driver adds the floors.

members.name: presenting_adapters
members.doc: Bit i set when the test driver def's adapter i presents to it.

members.name: fail
members.doc: Makes the surface's creation fail as the platform.
